builds.name: Reference: Repeated on-hit
builds.goal: Reference for Kog'Maw: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A stationary ranged damage engine who either exploits W's long-range max-health attacks or uses spells to soften enemies beyond attack range. Separate W's max-health attacks from R artillery and rising mana cost. Confirm phantom/bolt applications and Q shred rather than assigning full item damage to every spell. Actual attacks can combine on-hit effects, attack speed and stacked defenses/penetration.
testPlan: Kit question for Kog'Maw: Separate W's max-health attacks from R artillery and rising mana cost. Confirm phantom/bolt applications and Q shred rather than assigning full item damage to every spell.

Start with the early core (BotRK, then Rageblade) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Actual attacks can combine on-hit effects, attack speed and stacked defenses/penetration. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile which deals magic damage and corrodes the target's armor and magic resist for a short time. Kog'Maw also gains additional attack speed. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Ramp and target contact are required; on-attack effects are not all copied by phantom hits.

The route fails Kog'Maw's stated kit question: Separate W's max-health attacks from R artillery and rising mana cost. Confirm phantom/bolt applications and Q shred rather than assigning full item damage to every spell.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Ramp and target contact are required; on-attack effects are not all copied by phantom hits.
Full cost 16,300 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: BotRK, then Rageblade. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Terminus, Wit's End, Guardian Angel are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
